I've successfully implemented weekly subscription support for subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### Core Functionality (`src/cycles.js`):
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` to supported billing cycles
- Set weekly plan monthly cost calculation as `price × 52 ÷ 12` with `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE[CYCLE.WEEK] = 12/52`
- Implemented weekly charge calculation in `nextCharge()` - charges repeat every 7 days from `--since` date
- Changed `monthlyCents()` to use `Math.round()` instead of `Math.floor()` for nearest-cent rounding (per spec requirement)

### CLI Support (`bin/subtrack.js`):
- Updated USAGE to document `--every month|week|year`
- Added week/weekly to the EVERY mapping for `--every` flag validation
- Added `SHARE_PER_MONTH[CYCLE.WEEK] = 52/12` for monthly cost calculations
- Updated error message to reference "month, week, or year"

### Bug Fix (`src/renewals.js`):
- Fixed renewal sorting to use `date` instead of `when` short label, ensuring charges are listed chronologically (soonest first)

### Tests:
- Added comprehensive weekly plan tests covering:
  - `monthlyCents()` calculation for weekly plans
  - `nextCharge()` behavior for 7-day intervals
  - CLI add, list, and renewals commands with weekly plans
- Updated existing tests to expect nearest-cent rounding (e.g., €10.00 instead of €9.99 for yearly plans)

All 37 tests pass. The implementation correctly handles:
- ✓ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` 
- ✓ Weekly plans show €259.57/month (€59.90 × 52 ÷ 12, rounded)
- ✓ `subtrack renewals` lists weekly charges every 7 days
